purpose: Teach: キャロル/スクルージ/兵衛/モモ/ポップス/社民党/アントニオ/ピエール

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、クリスマス・キャロルの本を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Did you see? That regular customer was reading a Christmas Carol book the other day.
lines.style: Warm observation, like sharing a small discovery. Gentle pace, intimate — speaking to someone she trusts. Soft, almost tender trailing-off.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スクルージのような節約家でいらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh right, that one — the real penny-pincher, very Scrooge energy.
lines.style: Dry, knowing half-smile in the voice. Not unkind, just accurate. Quick, natural cadence like she's finishing Mei's thought.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、店主の息子さんを「兵衛」と呼んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they always call the owner's son by that old name — Heibei. Sweet, actually.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gentle. Slight pause before the name, like she's recalling it carefully. Warm recognition of the detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、モモ缶詰のスイーツがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They're really into those canned peach sweets, aren't they? Orders them every time.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation with quiet warmth underneath. Simple, conversational. The noticing that comes from paying attention.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ポップス音楽の60年代がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Loves sixties pop music — they mentioned it a few times actually.
lines.style: Reflective, like she's piecing together a small portrait. Moderate pace, nostalgic undertone. Natural, unhurried.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、社民党時代の選挙ポスターを集めてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They collect old election posters from the Socialist era, believe it or not.
lines.style: Surprised pleasure in the voice — charmed by the unexpected detail. Slight emphasis on the specificity. Warm, a little amused.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アントニオ・バンデラスの映画ファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Big Antonio Banderas fan, apparently. Has taste.
lines.style: Light, approving tone. Quick and direct. A small compliment tucked into casual observation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、フランス人ピエール氏との取引があるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they do business with this French guy, Pierre — that came up once.
lines.style: Factual, conversational wrap-up. Slower landing on the name. Soft close, like the conversation is gently settling.
